name: Selenium Grid 4.54 (Chrome + Firefox, Password)
description: Selenium Grid 4 hub with Chrome and Firefox nodes, behind a login.

SE_ROUTER_USERNAME.description: Grid login user (HTTP basic auth on every WebDriver and UI request).

SE_ROUTER_PASSWORD.description: Grid login password (12-128 characters). Empty or short locks the grid.

SE_REGISTRATION_SECRET.description: Shared secret nodes need to register with the hub.

SE_EXTERNAL_URL.description: Public URL the hub reports in session details.

PORT.description: Hub port; the public domain points here.

SE_SESSION_REQUEST_TIMEOUT.description: Seconds a new-session request waits in the queue for a free browser.

SE_ENABLE_TRACING.description: OpenTelemetry tracing; off (no collector in this template).

SE_EVENT_BUS_HOST.description: Hub address on the private network (event bus).

SE_REGISTRATION_SECRET.description: Must match the hub's secret, or the node cannot register.

SE_NODE_HOST.description: Address the hub uses to reach this node (private network).

PORT.description: Port of the node's /status endpoint for Railway's healthcheck.

SE_NODE_MAX_SESSIONS.description: Parallel Chrome sessions on this node. Each needs about 0.3-0.6 GB RAM more.

SE_NODE_OVERRIDE_MAX_SESSIONS.description: Allow SE_NODE_MAX_SESSIONS above the CPU count (Railway shows the host's CPUs).

SE_NODE_SESSION_TIMEOUT.description: Seconds without commands before an abandoned session is closed.

SE_SCREEN_WIDTH.description: Virtual screen width for non-headless sessions.

SE_SCREEN_HEIGHT.description: Virtual screen height for non-headless sessions.

SE_START_VNC.description: VNC viewing of sessions; off (no public port on Railway, saves RAM).

SE_ENABLE_TRACING.description: OpenTelemetry tracing; off (no collector in this template).

SE_JAVA_OPTS.description: JVM options of the node process (the browser runs outside the JVM).
